primer: MCX holds >98%–99% of Indian non-agri commodity derivatives, earning 71.4% ROCE and 76% Q2 FY27 margins. Pass 1 kept COMPOUNDER_PASS (PASS_WITH_WATCH) but flagged recurring IT opex, CME royalties, ~25% tax, and 15% dividend payout. Those frictions trim our Base Target to ₹4,150. Hold our 25 Zerodha shares (+2.50%) and raise the stop to ₹3,043.24. New cash waits for ₹3,343.80–₹3,460.00 (1.66:1 R:R vs 1.06:1 at ₹3,581.60).
